title: Figure 35: basic shared aperture beam control system (TILL, C4I)
description: Slide diagram titled "Basic Shared Aperture Beam Control System" showing a telescope with gyro, track camera, drive motor, TILL, laser, FSM, gimbals control and C4I system, with beam paths to an aircraft target. A side list gives "Sources of Noise & Jitter" such as platform vibration, target scintillation and atmospheric turbulence, and a banner reads "Overcomes many of the alignment issues with a dual aperture system." The caption defines TILL = Track Illuminator Laser and C4I, credited to the Directed Energy Professional Society.
